_doc: Traducción al inglés de visita-3d.html. La estructura vive en la página española; aquí solo el texto. Genera con ./i18n/gen-en.py
Recorre el pequeño planeta de ontos o pa: Explore ontos’s little planet or stroll through a miniature Segovia. A 3D experience with keyboard, mouse and touch controls.
ontos vivo · un mundo para explorar: ontos alive · a world to explore
Esta experiencia interactiva necesita Ja: This interactive experience requires JavaScript. Enable it to use the experience, or return to Applications to explore the other work.
Jardín 3D. WASD o flechas para caminar;: 3D garden. WASD or arrows to walk; Space to jump; Shift for turbo; E to pick up or plant; H to wave. Drag to look around.
El jardín necesita WebGL. Puedes volver: The garden needs WebGL. You can return to the 2D playground.
Pulsa Continuar o P para volver al jardí: Press Continue or P to return to the garden.
Un mundo pequeño, sin bordes. Camina alr: A little world with no edges. Walk around or zoom out to see it all.
Cómo jugar · teclado, cámara y objetivo: How to play · keyboard, camera and objective
<kbd>WASD / ↑↓←→</kbd> moverse hacia don: <kbd>WASD / ↑↓←→</kbd> move towards where you are looking · <kbd>Space</kbd> jump · <kbd>Shift</kbd> roll · <kbd>E</kbd> pick up, drop or plant · <kbd>H</kbd> wave · <kbd>P</kbd> pause. Drag the scenery to rotate the camera; use the mouse wheel to zoom. View planet shows the whole sphere; Follow ontos returns to the walk. On mobile, hold an arrow and use your other thumb to jump or drag the scenery. Pinch with two fingers to change distance.
Lleva la semilla al pedestal entre los a: Take the seed to the pedestal between the arches. The eight sparkles are an optional detour. You can go all the way around: gravity keeps you on the sphere. Restart begins a new garden.

Adaptación ontos: simplificación, recort: ontos adaptation: simplification, cropping, rotation, scaling and colouring without textures. Cathedral and aqueduct: original simplified geometry. This is a scenic miniature.
